goal:
In kestrel-team (Python; gate `uv run --locked python -m pytest tests/ -q`,
fully mocked, no network; base = main `a4fa505` or later), make the
claims check in `kestrel_team/core/cloud_audit.py` stop reading a commit
the task text itself names as a commit the run claims. READ CLAUDE.md
FIRST. Nothing else changes. Open no PR; the seat does.

The fact. `check_fetch_and_match` (line 278; loop at 295) resolves every
7–40 hex token in the RUN REPORT (`SHA_TOKEN`, line 68) and FAILs when one
is a commit not reachable from the tip. A RUN REPORT that truthfully
repeats a sha the task gave it — "cherry-pick `9a9c528`", "the base tree
was `c8c8a05`" — fails on that sha. Twice now: artemis-helm 0008 (seat
audit 2026-11-03: `fetch_and_match FAIL the report names commit(s) not on
the branch: 9a9c528`, the cherry-pick's source on origin's `cloud/0007-…`;
every other check PASS) and kestrel-helm 0082 (`… not on the branch:
c8c8a05`, 0081's pre-squash tip, named in the goal). The run did not
claim those commits; the shaper wrote them.

Do this. (1) A module-level `task_references(run_dir) -> set` in
`cloud_audit.py`: read `<run_dir>/TASK.md` (what prepare rendered and the
run read; `TASK_FILENAME` in `core/cloud.py` 103) and return
`set(SHA_TOKEN.findall(text))`; an absent TASK.md returns the empty set.
(2) In `audit()` (line 630), after `run_dir = resolve_run_dir(item_id)`
(641), exactly the line `    references = task_references(run_dir)`
(the declared mutation anchors on it), passed to `check_fetch_and_match`
(call at 699) as a new last parameter `references: set`. (3) In the loop
at 295: resolve each reference token the same way (`rev-parse --verify
--quiet <token>^{commit}`) into a set of full shas BEFORE the report
loop; a report token whose full sha is in that set is a reference, not a
claim — append it to `check.details["report_references"]`, do not test
it for reachability, do not count it in `named`. The tip rule is
unchanged (the report must still name the tip). PASS reason gains
`; N reference(s) the task names ignored` when N > 0. (4) docs/cloud.md
244–249: one sentence after "are not claims and are ignored." — a sha
the task text names (TASK.md) is the shaper's reference and is ignored
too, listed as `report_references`. (5) tests/test_cloud_audit.py, next
to `test_fetch_report_naming_a_sha_off_the_branch_fails` (345): a test
that commits on the target a branch the work branch does not contain,
writes that commit's 7-char sha into the run dir's `TASK.md`, names it in
the report with the tip, and asserts `fetch_and_match` PASS with the sha
in `details["report_references"]` and the reason ending `1 reference(s)
the task names ignored`; and a test that the same sha NOT in TASK.md
still FAILs with `not on the branch` (the existing 345 test covers the
task branch's own sha, which TASK.md can never name — keep it green).
Run the declared mutation by hand and quote the failing test's name.
Scope: `cloud_audit.py`, `docs/cloud.md`, `tests/test_cloud_audit.py`.
One commit on `cloud/0087-…`. RUN REPORT: the gate's last line, the
mutation run, the two new test names.
